highlight.title: Quips, Now on Mac and iPad
highlight.summary: Version 2.0 rebuilds Discover, gives your authors, tags and sources screens of their own, and lets you undo a delete, an edit, even a favorite.

points.title: On Your Mac
points.detail: A sidebar, a menu bar, real windows, and the shortcuts to drive them

points.title: Room to Spread Out
points.detail: A bigger window shows more of your library, and tidies up when you shrink it

points.title: See Where a Quote Came From
points.detail: Every quote in Discover tells you how solid its attribution is

releases.name: Quips Comes to the Mac and iPad
releases.summary: Keep your library on your Mac, your iPad and your phone, and get the same Quips on each — roomier where there's room, simple where there isn't. Browse a rebuilt Discover, see how solid a quote's attribution is before you save it, and take back almost anything you do.

features.title: Quips on Your Mac
features.detail: Quips is a Mac app in its own right now, rather than an iPad app in a window — with a sidebar, a menu bar, a Settings window, and as many windows open at once as you like.

features.title: Room to Spread Out
features.detail: Give Quips a bigger window and it uses the space: the sidebar comes out, and your library sits beside the quote you're reading. Make it small and it tidies back to a single column. Your iPad gets the full layout in portrait as well as landscape, and so does a big iPhone turned on its side.

features.title: Everything in the Sidebar
features.detail: Make a collection, rename a tag or open an author without a trip to Settings — they're all in the sidebar, next to Favorites, Discover, On This Day and Recently Deleted. It keeps what you use most at the top, and you choose what shows.

features.title: Built for the Keyboard
features.detail: Command-N for a new quote, Command-L to favorite, Command-F to search, arrow keys to move through your library, and Command-Down to open a quote in its own window. Select several at once, and find the whole list on the new Keyboard Shortcuts screen.

features.title: Undo
features.detail: Change your mind. Deleting a quote, writing one, editing one or favoriting one can all be taken back — Command-Z, or a shake on iPhone.

features.title: Select and File
features.detail: Select a handful of quotes and drag them onto a collection in the sidebar to file them. Hold Option as you drop to move them out of the one they came from.

features.title: Discover, Rebuilt
features.detail: Discover is a place you go to now, on every platform. Search finds the words inside the quotes rather than just the collection names, a new collection is featured each week, and you can share something you found without keeping it.

features.title: See Where a Quote Came From
features.detail: Every quote in Discover tells you how solid its attribution is — Verified, Widely attributed, Folk wisdom or Unconfirmed — on the card as well as on the quote's own screen.

features.title: Tags That Come With the Quote
features.detail: Save a quote from Discover and its topics come with it as tags. Search Discover for “grief” or “eulogy” and you'll find quotes that never use the word.

features.title: Everything by One Author, in One Place
features.detail: Authors, tags, sources and collections each have a screen of their own now, gathering every quote filed under them — with a little about the author or the source at the top.

features.title: A New Pin Format
features.detail: A 2:3 Pin format joins Square, Portrait, Story and Wide. On the Mac, Share Studio opens in a window of its own with the controls alongside.

features.title: Spotlight
features.detail: Search your device and quotes from your library turn up with everything else — tap one and it opens in Quips.

features.title: A New Default Look
features.detail: Quotes start in the Subtle style, the app wears Cyan to match its icon, and there are sixteen app icons to choose from — including Chevron and Paper, which change more than the color.

features.title: Backups That Keep Your Collections
features.detail: Exporting your library now saves your collections along with your quotes, including the empty ones.

features.title: A Tip Jar
features.detail: If you'd like to say thanks, there's a Tip Jar in Settings. Tips don't unlock anything.

releases.name: Widget Studio & Quote of the Day
releases.summary: Make your widgets your own, put a quote on your Lock Screen, and have quotes delivered exactly when you want them. Plus a lot more room on the free plan.

features.title: Widget Studio
features.detail: Design your Home Screen widgets in Settings → Widgets: choose the layout, the background color and gradient, the typeface, the text color and alignment, and which details to show, with a live preview at every size.

features.title: Lock Screen Widget
features.detail: Put a quote on your Lock Screen, drawn from your collections or from the Quote of the Day.

features.title: Quote of the Day
features.detail: Have a quote delivered on your own schedule — pick the time, the days and how often. One schedule on the free plan; Premium raises that to ten.

features.title: A Brighter Palette
features.detail: All sixteen quote colors were redrawn to be more vivid and to read well in both light and dark mode.

features.title: On This Day
features.detail: See which quotes were said on today's date, pin them to your library, or use them as your Quote of the Day.

features.title: Add a Whole Collection at Once
features.detail: Curated public collections have an "Add All to Library" button, so a whole collection joins your library in one go.

features.title: Quips Quest
features.detail: A checklist of first-time milestones that shows you around the app, with a celebration when you finish them.

features.title: 100 Free Quotes
features.detail: The free plan holds up to 100 quotes, so a full curated collection fits comfortably.

releases.name: Quote Style & Share Studio
releases.summary: Make your quotes pop with vibrant color, then share them your way. A redesigned Share Studio gives you full control over how every quote looks.

features.title: Quote Style
features.detail: Quotes show in vibrant color by default. Switch between the Bold and Subtle looks, recolor the text, and choose a typeface.

features.title: Share Studio
features.detail: Style a quote image before you share it — six card styles; Square, Portrait, Story and Wide sizes; light, dark and saturated backgrounds; and toggles for the author, date and source. Premium removes the watermark.

features.title: Source Types
features.detail: Note where a quote came from — book, movie, podcast, speech and more — each with a matching icon.

features.title: Copy Any Quote
features.detail: Press and hold a quote to copy it, along with its author and date.

features.title: More Personalization
features.detail: New collection icons and colors, plus a Salmon app icon (Premium).

releases.name: Daily Quotes & Story Sharing
releases.summary: Build a daily habit with a quote delivered right when you want it, and share your favorites as tall Story images made for social.

features.title: Daily Quote
features.detail: Have a quote delivered at a time you pick. Turn it on in Settings.

features.title: Share as Stories
features.detail: Share any quote as a tall 9:16 image made for Stories, alongside the classic square.

features.title: Share from a Widget
features.detail: Medium and large Home Screen widgets have a one-tap share button.

features.title: Welcome Walkthrough
features.detail: A short first-run tour, so you can start saving quotes right away.

features.title: Backups Keep More
features.detail: Import and export now preserve collection membership and your tag colors.

features.title: Search and Widgets
features.detail: Search finds quotes by author or tag, and widgets refresh right after you make a change.

releases.name: Public Collections
releases.summary: Discover and add quotes from curated public collections. Browse philosophy, creativity, tech wisdom and more, all inside the app.

features.title: Browse Public Collections
features.detail: Explore curated collections on philosophy, creativity, tech and more.

features.title: Add with a Swipe
features.detail: Add a quote from a public collection to your library with a swipe.

features.title: Duplicate Detection
features.detail: Already added a quote? Quips shows you the copy you have, so you can edit that one instead.

features.title: Quotes in Several Collections
features.detail: A quote can belong to more than one collection.

releases.name: Collections
releases.summary: Group your quotes by theme, by mood, or any way you like, with collections of your own.

features.title: Collections of Your Own
features.detail: Create collections like Inspiration, Work Wisdom or Daily Motivation.

features.title: Assign as You Write
features.detail: Put a quote in a collection while you're writing or editing it.

features.title: Filter by Collection
features.detail: Choose a collection to see only its quotes.

features.title: 25 Collections with Premium
features.detail: Create up to 25 collections with a Premium subscription.

releases.name: Siri Shortcuts & Share Extension
releases.summary: Save a quote from anywhere on your device, and use Siri to add one without opening the app.

features.title: Share Extension
features.detail: Save quotes straight from Safari, Notes, Books, and any app that shares text.

features.title: Siri
features.detail: Say "Add a quote to Quips" or "Get a random quote from Quips".

features.title: Shortcuts
features.detail: Build automations with Quips in the Shortcuts app.

features.title: Premium on Every Device
features.detail: Your Premium status syncs across all your devices.

releases.name: Sharing & Widgets
releases.summary: Share your favorite quotes as images, and see a quote on your Home Screen with the new widgets.

features.title: Four Sharing Styles
features.detail: Choose Minimal, Bold, Classic or Text when you share a quote.

features.title: Swipe to Share
features.detail: Share any quote with a swipe.

features.title: Home Screen Widgets
features.detail: Add a widget to see a random favorite through the day.

features.title: VoiceOver Support
features.detail: Improved accessibility throughout the app.

releases.name: Import & Export
releases.summary: Take your quotes anywhere. Export your library for safekeeping, or import quotes from elsewhere.

features.title: Export Your Quotes
features.detail: Save your whole library as a file you can keep.

features.title: Import Quotes
features.detail: Bring in quotes from a backup or another source.

features.title: Recently Deleted
features.detail: Deleted a quote by accident? Recover it within 30 days.

releases.name: Hello, World!
releases.summary: Say hello to Quips — your new home for the quotes worth keeping.

features.title: Save Your Quotes
features.detail: Start with 25 free, or save as many as you like with Premium.

features.title: Organize with Tags
features.detail: Tag a quote so you can find it again.

features.title: Track Authors
features.detail: Keep track of who said what.

features.title: Mark Favorites
features.detail: Favorite the quotes you love most.

features.title: Search Everything
features.detail: Search your whole library.

features.title: iCloud Sync
features.detail: Your quotes on all your devices, automatically.

features.title: Light & Dark Mode
features.detail: Quips follows your system appearance.

features.title: Custom App Icons
features.detail: Personalize your Home Screen (Premium).
